```yaml
name: Build Linux System Libraries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Qt libraries
        uses: tlambert03/setup-qt-libs@19e4ef2d781d81f5f067182e228b54ec90d23b76

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libffmpeg-dev \
            libqt5core5a libqt5gui5 libqt5widgets5 libqt5multimedia5-plugins \
            libqt5multimedia5 libqt5multimediawidgets5

      - name: Configure build
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
                   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
                   -DSYSTEM_LIBS=ON \
                   -DHARDSUBX=${{ matrix.variant == 'hardsubx' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Install
        run: |
          cd build
          sudo make install

      - name: Verify dynamic linking
        run: |
          echo "ldd for ccextractor:"
          ldd /usr/bin/ccextractor
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" = "hardsubx" ]; then
            echo "ldd for ccextractor-hardsubx:"
            ldd /usr/bin/ccextractor-hardsubx
          fi

      - name: Upload binaries
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}
          path: /usr/bin/ccextractor*
```
